title: HueysUtils
body:
# Huey's Utils

Commands:

- `/adventure` Switch between adventure / survival mode, useful when you use auto clickers in farms but don't want to break it by accident
- `/query <time|slimechunk|difficulty|datapacks>` These informations should not be OPs-only
- `/thorns` Temporarily disables Thorns enchantment from all pieces of your armors, use again to restore

Experimental:

- `/friendly` In friendly mode, you won't take damage from other players but can't damage other players either
